findings.effect: The PATCH step endpoint silently ignores null instead of clearing description, plannedDurationHours, startedAt, dueAt, completedAt and gamify. Existing values remain stored, breaking the contract for clearing these fields.

set_step_due_date compares only the calendar day in the server's local timezone, so a time change within the same day is rejected as no_change. Whether two instants count as the same day also depends on the server's timezone.

Proposal and application each generate new step ids, so stepId values in add_step and add_section previews never match the ids stored. This causes trouble if the frontend or a later turn refers to those preview ids.
